description: Real-looking risk-off events reported by at least two independent credible sources (or an official source plus independent reporting). A careful classifier ends with a restriction: REDUCE_SIZE or BLOCK_NEW_LONGS. With today's tiers every GDELT outlet is MEDIUM (weight 0.65), so decayed severity tops out in REDUCE_SIZE unless an official source is among the independent families.

cases.summary: Exchange hot-wallet breach reported by a wire and two crypto newsrooms.

items.title: Crypto exchange Kryvex halts withdrawals after $1.2 billion hot-wallet breach
Kryvex confirms hack, says about $1.2B in bitcoin and ether drained from hot wallets
On-chain data shows stolen Kryvex funds moving through mixers

cases.why: Three independent outlets with their own headlines and reporting (a wire plus two crypto newsrooms) confirm a large exchange hack. All are MEDIUM tier, so the effect is a size reduction; a block is also acceptable.

cases.summary: Large exchange hack confirmed by two outlets while the market sells off on heavy volume.

items.title: Hackers steal $680 million from Singapore-based exchange Meridex
Meridex exploit: attacker drains ETH and stablecoins, deposits suspended

cases.why: Two independent sources and a confirming selloff (about -0.8 % on 3x volume in the first 15 minutes).

cases.summary: Exchange key compromise reported by three independent outlets.

items.title: Crypto exchange Northgate freezes withdrawals after suspected private-key compromise
Northgate Digital says attackers accessed signing keys; users told not to deposit
Northgate's hot wallets emptied in 40 minutes, blockchain sleuths say

cases.why: Three independent newsrooms, each with its own reporting, confirm the compromise.

cases.summary: Ethereum stops finalizing after a client bug; ETH sells off.

items.title: Ethereum blocks stop finalizing for over an hour after client bug
Ethereum finality stalls as consensus-client bug hits validators
Ethereum developers rush out patch after network fails to finalize

cases.why: A protocol-critical bug on Ethereum confirmed by three outlets; the risk is to ETH, not BTC.

cases.summary: A large stablecoin breaks its peg; two outlets and a selloff.

items.title: Stablecoin ARVD slips to 91 cents as issuer Arvelle pauses redemptions
Third-largest stablecoin ARVD breaks its dollar peg, redemptions halted

cases.why: A stablecoin depeg is a listed protocol incident; two independent sources and the market confirm it.

cases.summary: Coinbase status page reports a trading halt; a news outlet independently reports it.

items.title: Trading halted on all order books
items.excerpt: We are investigating an issue affecting order matching. Trading is halted on all order books while we investigate. Customer funds are safe.

items.title: Coinbase halts trading on all markets, citing order-matching issue

cases.why: Official primary source plus independent reporting qualifies. A halt at a major venue is a volatility risk for new longs; funds are not at risk, so a reduction is the ideal answer and a block is acceptable.

cases.summary: Missile strikes on tankers near the Strait of Hormuz; markets sell off.

items.title: Missiles strike tankers near Strait of Hormuz; oil jumps 9%
US Navy says commercial ships attacked in Gulf; Iran-backed group claims strike
Shipping halted in Strait of Hormuz after attacks on vessels

cases.why: Two wires and a third independent outlet confirm an escalation; the market confirms the risk-off move.

cases.summary: Missile strike near a NATO border; emergency consultations.

items.title: NATO allies invoke Article 4 after missile strike near Polish border town
Poland says missile hit farm near Ukraine border, calls emergency NATO talks

cases.why: A major military incident confirmed by two independent outlets; the market has not reacted yet, which the rules do not require when two sources agree.

cases.summary: Blockade drills around Taiwan reported by three outlets.

items.title: China announces live-fire blockade drills around Taiwan, ships told to avoid area
Beijing launches large-scale military exercises encircling Taiwan
Taiwan raises alert level as Chinese warships surround island

cases.why: A shipping and military shock confirmed by three independent outlets and a selloff.

cases.summary: SEC emergency action freezes assets of a large exchange; a newspaper reports it.

items.title: SEC Charges Altora Global and Its Founder With Operating an Unregistered Crypto Exchange and Misusing Customer Assets
items.excerpt: The Securities and Exchange Commission today filed an emergency action and obtained a temporary restraining order freezing the assets of Altora Global, one of the largest crypto asset trading platforms by volume.

items.title: SEC wins emergency asset freeze against crypto exchange Altora

cases.why: An official primary source plus independent reporting: an asset freeze at one of the largest venues is a strong risk-off event. OFFICIAL weight allows a block.

cases.summary: Prosecutors charge a large exchange and its founders; accounts frozen.

items.title: US charges crypto exchange Zanthor and top executives with fraud; accounts frozen
Zanthor founders arrested in New York as prosecutors unseal indictment

cases.why: Two independent wires confirm a major enforcement action; the market sells off.

cases.summary: A large jurisdiction cuts bank transfers to crypto exchanges.

items.title: South Korea orders banks to suspend fiat transfers to crypto exchanges
Korean regulators freeze won on-ramps to exchanges pending review

cases.why: A large-jurisdiction restriction confirmed by two independent outlets and a selloff.

cases.summary: SEC suspends trading in a spot bitcoin ETF; a wire reports it.

items.title: SEC Suspends Trading in Halvorsen Bitcoin Trust Shares Over Pricing Irregularities
items.excerpt: The Commission today issued an order suspending trading in shares of the Halvorsen Bitcoin Trust for ten days, citing questions about the accuracy of the trust's reported holdings.

items.title: SEC halts trading in spot bitcoin ETF over holdings questions

cases.why: Official SEC order plus independent wire reporting; a spot-ETF suspension hits BTC market structure directly.

cases.summary: A court vacates the approval of spot ether ETFs; ETH sells off.

items.title: Appeals court vacates SEC approval of spot ether ETFs, orders creations halted
Court ruling forces spot ether ETFs to stop issuing new shares

cases.why: Two independent sources on an ETF-structure shock that affects ETH; without an official source the ETF TTL stays at its 4-hour minimum.

cases.summary: FOMC statement announces a surprise half-point hike; a broadcaster reports it.

items.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
items.excerpt: In support of its goals, the Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/2 percentage point, citing a renewed rise in inflation.

items.title: Fed unexpectedly raises rates by half a point; stocks and bitcoin slide

cases.why: The official statement plus independent reporting of a surprise hike, with a confirming selloff.

cases.summary: Fed chair signals renewed hikes; two wires report it and markets fall.

items.title: Fed chair says rate hikes are back on the table as inflation re-accelerates
Fed chair surprises markets with hawkish turn; Treasury yields jump

cases.why: A Fed-speaker surprise confirmed by two independent wires and a selloff.

cases.summary: CPI comes in far above forecasts; official release plus a wire.

items.title: Consumer Price Index - October 2026
items.excerpt: The Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers rose 0.8 percent on a seasonally adjusted basis in October, the largest monthly increase in more than four years.

items.title: US consumer prices surge 0.8% in October, far above forecasts

cases.why: The official release plus independent reporting of an inflation shock, and a selloff. Macro events decay fast (3-hour TTL), so after 17 minutes the decayed severity sits just under the block threshold.

cases.summary: Producer prices jump; two newspapers report it and markets fall.

items.title: US producer prices jump 1.1% in November, biggest gain since 2022
PPI shock: wholesale inflation spikes, rattling stocks and crypto

cases.why: Two independent outlets on a macro surprise, confirmed by the market.

cases.summary: A liquidation wave as bitcoin drops sharply.

items.title: Crypto liquidations top $1.4 billion in an hour as bitcoin drops 3%
Bitcoin tumbles as leveraged bets unwind in biggest liquidation wave this quarter

cases.why: A forced-deleveraging event confirmed by two sources and a sharp high-volume drop; liquidation events decay within two hours.

cases.summary: Ether longs liquidated in a cascade.

items.title: Ether open interest collapses as $900 million in longs are liquidated
ETH drops 3% in minutes as cascading liquidations sweep exchanges

cases.why: Two independent sources and a confirming market move; the cascade centres on ETH but spills into BTC, so either asset set is acceptable.

cases.summary: Long liquidations as bitcoin breaks a round-number level.

items.title: Over $1.5 billion in longs liquidated as bitcoin slides below $67,000
Bitcoin breaks below $67K, triggering a wave of forced selling

cases.why: Two independent crypto outlets and a sharp high-volume drop that matches the reported level.

cases.summary: A large liquid-staking protocol freezes after a critical bug; its token depegs.

items.title: Liquid-staking giant Stakewell pauses withdrawals after critical bug disclosure
stwETH slides from its ether peg as Stakewell freezes contracts

cases.why: A protocol-critical bug in a major ETH staking protocol, confirmed by two outlets and an ETH selloff.

cases.summary: A top exchange suspends withdrawals on every network.

items.title: Top crypto exchange Varkon suspends withdrawals on all networks after infrastructure failure
Varkon halts crypto withdrawals globally, cites wallet infrastructure issue

cases.why: A listed major-exchange incident confirmed by two independent sources and a selloff.

cases.summary: Air strikes inside Iran and a vow of retaliation.

items.title: Israel strikes military sites inside Iran; Tehran vows retaliation
Explosions reported across Iran after Israeli air strikes
Iran says it will respond decisively after Israeli attack

cases.why: A Middle East escalation confirmed by three independent outlets and a selloff.

cases.summary: The custodian of several spot bitcoin ETFs discloses a breach.

items.title: Custodian for several spot bitcoin ETFs discloses security breach, freezes transfers
Bitcoin ETF custodian halts withdrawals after cyberattack

cases.why: Two independent wires on a custody breach behind BTC ETFs; the category sits between hack and ETF structure, so either is accepted.
